text:
emma_fin: FYI seeing an unexpected ~$6.4k GPU charge on Saturday night that doesn't show up against any team tags in the daily export. Can ops triage?

ops_bot: Alert: Unattributed GPU spend (+$6,372) at 2026-02-08 02:17 UTC. Auto-ticket GUID-913 created.

harry_ops: Quick peek at the billing dump shows ~95 VM rows with empty `allocation_label`. Zone cluster: us-east4-b. Query: ```sql
SELECT instance_name, labels, cost FROM `billing.gcp_daily` WHERE date='2026-02-08' AND product='Compute Engine' ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 100;
```

kate_sre: We had a metadata-plane blip in us-east4 during that window — metadata server returned 503 for ~12 mins. Some startup scripts didn’t retry, so labels weren't set. SRE issued incident 2026-02-08-META and a fix to the init script adding exponential backoff.

marta_fin: For month-end we prefer to map costs back to teams when there's evidence (creating user, project id). If not, default to `infra-unassigned`. Can ops produce a provisional allocation so we don't fail budget alerts?

harry_ops: Plan: 1) attempt retro-tag join using audit logs (instance create operation -> actor) 2) for remaining rows, fall back to pro-rate across active projects weighted by gpu_hours 3) account for reserved commit absorption before pro-rate. I can run step 1 and post a CSV.

emma_fin: That waterfall sounds good. Please keep reserved commit matching first — finance will subtract committed capacity before any pro-rate. Also check whether any promo credits ran out mid-month and need to be split.

ops_bot: Retro-join job queued: billing.retro_tag_job_2026_02_08. Estimated run time 20m.

harry_ops: Ran retro-join. Attached provisional CSV (s3://billing-exports/provisional/gpu_backfill_2026-02-08.csv). Mapped ~70% of cost by creator principal, remaining ~30% unassigned.

marta_fin: Received. I'll accept a provisional assignment to `nonprod-experiments` for reporting but need the audit logs and the join query for the final reclassification.

kate_sre: PR with startup script fix: https://git.redwood.ai/sre/init-scripts/pull/210 — adds retries + logs allocation label failures to Cloud Logging. We'll keep the retry in place for 7 days, then roll into stable image.

harry_ops: For the final step I computed pro-rate shares after consuming reserved commit (commit absorbed 18% of total GPU hours). Pseudocode used: ```py
commit_consumed = min(commit_capacity_hours, total_hours)
remaining_cost = total_cost - cost_of(commit_consumed)
per_project_share = (project_hours / remaining_hours) * remaining_cost
```
CSV includes `provisional_owner`, `method`, `allocated_cost`.

marta_fin: Thanks. Mark GUID-913 as provisional -> `nonprod-experiments` in dashboards to suppress alerts. We'll re-run allocation and adjust the month-end close once you submit the audit logs + final CSV.

ops_bot: GUID-913 status updated: provisional assignment set to nonprod-experiments. Recheck scheduled every 3 hours.

emma_fin: Please ensure the PR and audit logs are linked on the ticket. If the backfill changes more than 5% of the provisional assignment, finance needs a short note explaining variance.

harry_ops: Will do — uploading audit logs and join SQL to GUID-913 now. ETA for final backfill: EOD Monday.

emma_fin: Great. If anyone notices similar unlabeled bursts over the weekend, DM me so we can preempt budget alerts.
